full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Abdul Quddus, J.: Rule was issued under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure at the instance of convict-appellant-petitioner namely Abdul Hakim Talukder, calling upon sole state opposite Party represented by Deputy Commissioner and District Magistrate Lalmonirhat to show cause as to why impugned Judgment and order dated 16.02.2006 by learned Sessions Judge Lalmonirhat rejecting out right the memo criminal appeal No.8/06 refusing the prayer under section 5 of Limitation Act for condo nation of delay of 234 days in preferring the same appeal against Judgment and order of conviction of 1 year R.I. with fine by Magistrate 1st Class, Lalmonirhat in C.R. case no.141/02 under section 6(5) Muslim Family Law Ordinance 1961 should not be set aside or to pass such order or orders as to this court may deem fit and proper. 

 3. It has been stated that the petitioner being quite unaware of the above Judgment against him, was suddenly arrested on 22.1.06and taken to custody. He was grated bail on 25.01.06 by the trial court enabling him to file appeal which was preferred being no.8/06 on 16.02.06 with application under section 5 Limitation Act for condo nation of delay of 234 days. But the memo of appeal no.8/06 was rejected by the Sessions Judge, Lalmonirhat refusing the prayer for condo nation under section 5 Limitation Act vide Judgment dated 16.2.06. The convict appellant petitioner A. Hakim Talukder filed this criminal Revision no. 522/06 on 26.2.06 along with some papers including Annexure-A being an affidavit dated 25.1.06 sworn in before Notary Public Lalmonirhat by Roshna Khatun (wife of petitioner) disclosing fact of compromise of cases with her husband petitioner including C.R. no. 141/02. 

 4. In a supplementary affidavit dated 23.5.06 filed in criminal Revision no. 522/06 by convict-appellant-petitioner A. Hakim Talukder stating that in the application filed under section 5 Limitation Act along with memo of appeal no. 8/06 before Id. Sessions Judge, Lalmonirhat such above fact as to affidavit dated 25.1.06 by wife Roshna Khatun about compromise of cases between husband and wife including C.R. case no.141/02 was not through oversight mentioned there in and as a result Learned. Sessions Judge could not consider such above fact resulting in erroneous decision as to rejection of the memo refusing prayer for condo nation of the delay as above. 

 8. He submits that due to non-mentioning about said Annexure-A (affidavit dated 25.1.06) in the application under section 5 of Limitation Act filed in criminal appeal no.8/06 on 16.2.06 1d. Sessions Judge disbelieved the plea of absence of petition in the case of C.R. 141/02 due to compromise of the appellant with Roshna Khatun complainant of. C.R. 141/02 and rejected memo of appeal no 8/06 refusing the prayer for condo nation under section 5 Limitation Act. 

 9. Learned Advocate earnestly submits that if said affidavit dated 25.1.06 of wife Roshna Khatun would have been placed before Id. Sessions Judge and if, fact of such affidavit was mentioned in application under section 5 Limitation Act Id. Sessions Judge would not have rejected the memo out right vide impugned Judgment and order dated 16.2.06. 

 10. Ld. Advocate also submits that if the impugned Judgment and order as to rejection of the memo of appeal no.8/06 and refusal of the prayer under section 5 Limitation Act for condo nation of the delay stands good the convict appellant petitioner will be deprived of any chance to seek legal remedy against impugned order of conviction and sentence dated 27.4.05 and this will operate to the prejudice of the petitioner. 

 11. He also submits that the impugned order of rejection of the memo of Appeal no. 8/06 refusing prayer under section 5 Limitation Act for condo nation delay should be set aside by making the Rule absolute in order that the appeal be admitted so that the appellant petitioner may seek the legal relief from the appellate court. He submits that the Rule must be made absolute. 

 14. From Annexure-"A" of application under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure such as affidavit dated 25.1.06 of Roshna Khatun sworn before Notary Public Lalmonirhat as mentioned in supplementary affidavit filed on 23.5.06 by petitioner it appears that said Roshna Khatun disclosed about compromise of their disputes along with pending cases including C.R. case no.141/02 between them as husband and wife. It is obvious that if there was mention in the application under section 5 limitation Act before Sessions Judge about affidavit dated 25.1.06 before Notary Public as well as if the said affidavit dated 25.1.06 Roshna Khatun was filed before Id. Sessions Judge, Lalmonirhat at the hearing of condo nation prayer, definitely Id. Sessions Judge would not have rejected the prayer for condo nation vide impugned Judgment and order. 

 15. When such above fact about affidavit dated 25.1.06 by Roshna Khatun before Notary Public Lalmonirhat about compromise of dispute with her husband present petitioner A. Hakim Talukder has been brought to the notice of the court by appellant dated 23.5.06, plea of convict appellant petitioner disclosed in application under section 5 Limitation Act gets support and strength and in above context this court feels that the prayer for condo nation of delay should be allowed in order that the convict-appellant petitioner may proceed with the appeal preferred before Sessions Judge, Lalmonirhat to get the legal remedy in the matter as prayed for. This court is thus inclined to consider the prayer for condonation of the delay favorable in special view of the matter that marriage between the parties still subsists and to maintain the above relationship in tact impugned order as to rejection of the memo of appeal and refusal of the prayer for condo nation calls for interference.
